segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the cream felt good on application with no irritation, leaving her skin feeling less dry than before.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports it became her go-to after other products stopped working for her, describing fewer breakouts and skin that looks healthier, glowing, and plumped.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or eczema-prone skin, including one who calls her skin super sensitive, report the cream is gentle and does not cause breakouts.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin found the cream not too thick and reports visible firming results.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as aging, including one recovering skin firmness after significant weight loss, generally report visible improvement in firmness and elasticity, though one reviewer who bought it for her aging, line-prone skin found it very drying and had to stop using it.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers who comment on firmness or fine lines report visible improvement — smoother, firmer skin, a lift in the cheek area, or fine lines that are practically gone, including one recovering skin firmness after significant weight loss; several others, however, report no noticeable difference in fine lines or lifting even after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report the cream leaves skin feeling hydrated, plump, and soft, including some who specifically note it improved existing dryness; one reviewer, however, found it very drying and had to stop using it entirely.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her face became red after use and suspects an ingredient allergy; by contrast, another describes only a temporary pink glow with no discomfort, and others report their skin looking less red after use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who mention breakouts report the cream does not cause new blemishes, including one with oily skin who returned to the product after breaking out on something else and now reports fewer breakouts.

extraits.texte: I bought this moisterizer in January. I usually purchase the Super Restorative Day Cream and thought I'd try the Extra Firming Energy since I am getting older and have more lines than I have had. Unfortunately this moisterizer dried out my skin and I had to stop using it. I ended up purchasing the Super Restorative Day Cream which has made my skin very happy.
I brought this 3 weeks ago hoping it will help firm my skin. However I may be allergic to some ingredients and my face is red after I use it.

extraits.titre: Extra firming enter my go to product
extraits.texte: I have really oily skin and products stop working after 3 weeks. I used Clarins years ago, and stopped because of my skin issues and the price. A few months ago I noticed increase in pimples and skin breakdown. Decided to go back to Clarins. My skin has never looked healthier. Extra form energy is now part of my of my daily routine. I have less breakouts. My skin is glowing and plumped.

extraits.titre: Makes my skin feel softer, and look better.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Clarins Extra Firming Energy crème has a pleasant scent, made me think of a light rose scent. It felt light and creamy. It went in smoothly. It felt good on my dry skin. After applying, I felt as if my face kinda turned pink/reddish. There was no discomfort and no irritation as such, just a slight pink glow. Overall, using this product did a good job moisturizing my skin. After using the entire sample, I felt that my overall face looks better and feels softer and not as dry as before I starting using this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Clarins extra firming day cream had some positives but fell short in other areas. The cream is moisturizing with a slight glow, but the texture is a bit heavy. Additionally, I didn't really notice a difference in fine lines. Also to note, the fragrance is a bit strong.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] One of the things that I'm starting to notice about my aging skin is a loss in elasticity and firmness. I enjoyed using this skincare as part of my morning routine and it's nighttime equivalent. I did notice a difference in the firmness and supple hydration that my skin had after using both products, but this one was really nice and lightweight and performed well under my sunscreen
I absolutely loved this product. It absorbed perfectly into my skin. I also have super sensitive skin and it didn't break me out at all. If you're looking for a good moisturizer this is the one.
